subject: Proposal: Hosted API provisioning uplift & soft-fail routing
messages:
From: Megan Ortiz To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com Cc: procurement@edgecart.com, Tom Hale Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: Hosted capacity uplift — path & timing Hi Stephanie, Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran usage projections and expect sustained token throughput to increase by ~3.2x from Sept onward; peak windows will be concentrated 08:00-11:00 PT. Procurement asked me to get a concrete path for: - a temporary uplift in monthly committed units for Q4 (target start 2028-09-01) - a soft-fail / fallback routing plan if we exceed our new rate limits - estimated impact on unit price and timing for provisioning Can you send a recommended approach and an ops checklist so we can circulate internally? Attaching the traffic heatmap we discussed. Best, Megan Ortiz Head of Product EdgeCart Inc. Attachments: edgecart_traffic_heatmap_aug2028.png (image/png) From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com To: Megan Ortiz Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — path & timing Megan — thanks for the details and the heatmap, that helps. High-level proposal below; I attached a provisioning playbook and a draft SOW for your procurement team. 1) Recommended commitment uplift - Baseline monthly commit: increase by 3.5x (gives ~10% buffer) - Add burst pocket sized at 15% of new commit for peak smoothing 2) Rate / pricing - New unit price: apply step-tier pricing tied to the commit band (included in SOW draft) - We can offer a short-term promotional uplift credit for Q4 to ease the transition — karthik, please confirm suggested credit band
3) Soft-fail & routing - Primary routing: new pinned hosted model cluster in us-west (low-latency) - Fallback policy: if throughput > 110% sustained over 5m, route to a compatible slightly lower-cost model (same API surface) and apply token-priority headers so customer can choose graceful degradation - Ops hooks: KV cache priming + pre-warming requests during scheduled peaks 4) Timeline & ops checklist - Sign SOW (DocuSign link) -> provision reserved pool -> runway for validation (3 business days) -> go-live target 2028-09-01 Next steps: I can schedule a 30-min alignment call tomorrow with our platform ops and your infra team. If procurement wants a revised SOW (term adjustments, invoice cadence), we’ll iterate. Attachments: EdgeCart_Provisioning_Playbook_v1.xlsx; Redwood_Provisioning_SOW_draft.pdf Cheers, Stephanie Nguyen Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com (415) 555-0192 From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 09:30:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — path & timing Stephanie — happy to support the Q4 uplift. A few clarifying points for pricing and contract: - Promotional credit: recommend 10% on the incremental commit for the first two months (to help with adoption/testing). If they commit 12 months, we can move to 12% off incremental. - Invoice cadence: monthly with pre-pay option; procurement usually prefers net-30. - Metrics we’ll require: token consumption per route, 95th percentile latency per model, and boolean flag for whether fallback routing was invoked. We’ll bake those into the SOW monitoring section. Also, can ops outline exact fallback mapping? I want to ensure we don't accidentally route to a model with different output characteristics. Logan? — Karthik On Thu, Aug 23, 2028 at 10:05 AM Logan Wright wrote: From: logan_wright@redwood.com To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — path & timing Stephanie / Karthik — quick ops note (cc Marissa for CS): Fallback mapping proposal: - Primary: rwd-large-v2 (fp16) in us-west (latency-optimized) - Fallback A (capacity-preserving): rwd-large-v2-8q (quantized) — same token semantics, small quality delta - Fallback B (cost-preserving): rwd-medium-v2 (lower-context) — degrade gracefully with token budget recommendations Technical safeguards: - Auto-prefix cache retention during peak windows to reduce cold-starts - Per-tenant token throttles enforced at gateway with an escalation window to avoid hard 429s for transient spikes - Telemetry: emit a fallback_invoked metric with reason codes (capacity, rate-limit, region) Ops is comfortable guaranteeing a 3-business-day provision lead once SOW signed and onboarding checklist completed. — Logan From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com To: Megan Ortiz , Tom Hale Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 11:40:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — path & timing Megan / Tom — attaching the SOW draft with the rates and the provisioning playbook. Key things to scan: - Section 2.1: Commit uplift bands and unit pricing table - Section 3.2: Fallback policy and explicit list of models used for graceful degradation - Appendix A: Ops checklist and telemetry keys (fallback_invoked, route_latency_p95) Proposed next steps: 1) Procurement reviews SOW and confirms invoice cadence (net-30 vs pre-pay) 2) Sign via DocuSign -> we provision reserved pool -> 3-business-day validation window 3) Post-go-live 14-day guardrail with weekly sync between EdgeCart infra and Redwood ops If procurement is ready, I’ll send the DocuSign link with the credit option (10% promotional credit) pre-selected. Thanks, Stephanie Attachments: Redwood_Provisioning_SOW_draft.pdf; EdgeCart_Provisioning_Playbook_v1.xlsx From: Tom Hale To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com Cc: Megan Ortiz , procurement@edgecart.com Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Hosted capacity uplift — path & timing Stephanie — this looks good and aligns with our timeline. Procurement has two quick asks before signature: 1) Can you confirm SLA language around routing fallback (we need assurance that fallback won’t be used without a 5m sustained threshold and that we are notified within 15 minutes when invoked)? 2) Request to add an invoice milestone for the provisioning credit to be applied on the first invoice post-go-live. If you can confirm those two items, we’ll route the SOW for internal approval Monday and aim to sign by Wednesday. — Tom Hale Director, Infrastructure EdgeCart Inc.
